decisions.reason: The training programme fits the firm's existing service, application and training capabilities, and its multi-year standalone presence suggests the firm can learn from customers and profitably embed it in the core offer.
Although technically related to the installed machine base, it was only briefly mentioned and not sustained as a visible offer, so the weak market signal does not justify dedicated resources.

Hybrid additive post-processing is distant from the firm's established knowledge base and showed only fleeting market visibility, making it harder to absorb lessons and improve it commercially than for core products.
A high-speed CNC milling machine is very close to the firm's core machinery and application know-how, so its strong absorptive capacity and in-house R&D support keeping and refining it.

The automatic tool change system builds directly on the firm's modular engineering and productivity-focused offer, and its dedicated launch suggests a meaningful extension the firm can improve internally.
